description: This add-on allows you to get information about your public IP address (such as country, city, ISP, and more) by pressing NVDA+Shift+I.
changelog:
Initial release:
- Fetch and announce public IP information with NVDA+Shift+I (press again to cancel).
- Configurable fields (IP address, country, country code, region, city, ZIP, ISP, organization, AS, latitude, longitude, timezone) in NVDA Settings.
- Option to display results in a browsable message window.
- Respects system proxy settings and plays progress beeps while fetching.
